basic_profile.bio: I'm a 26-year-old tech enthusiast living in Chino Hills, California. I recently got into virtual reality gaming after purchasing a Quest 2, and I've been exploring psychedelic experiences through VR. I'm a night owl, often online between midnight and 4 a.m., and I work as a freelance web developer during the day. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my free time gaming, exploring new technologies, and occasionally experimenting with psychedelics.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science and have been working as a freelance web developer for the past three years. My interest in technology extends to VR and gaming, where I am mostly self-taught. I often learn through online courses and community forums.
